name: Emily Chen
headline: Junior Content Marketing Specialist
summary: Junior content marketer with 2 years of experience developing SEO-driven content strategies for B2C brands. Skilled in blog writing, keyword research, and content calendar management. Passionate about crafting engaging narratives that improve organic visibility and audience engagement.

responsibilities: Develop and execute monthly content calendars aligned with SEO goals
Conduct keyword research to identify content opportunities
Write and edit blog posts, landing pages, and email newsletters
Collaborate with design team to produce visual content assets
Monitor content performance using Google Analytics and adjust strategy accordingly
Assisted in drafting social media captions and blog drafts
Supported on-page SEO audits for client websites
Compiled monthly performance reports for content campaigns
Helped coordinate influencer outreach for product launches
